notes: Study blocks stay off lecture times. Quest parts get realistic times: reading minutes come from the lesson text and your own reading speed, and passive parts run on their own clock. Saving a quest only merges each page's own changes, so a second device can't wipe your answers. Attach buttons open the file picker with one tap in the Claude app. The setup page retires once the semester is set up. The nightly run is built from the attached repo and passes the safety check.
